question: Who won the third edition of the BBC Indian Sportswoman of the Year Award in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is '**__Mirabai Chanu__'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Weightlifter Mirabai Chanu won the BBC Indian Sportswoman of the Year award for 2021 on 29 March 2022.
 
• Chanu became the first Indian weightlifter to win a silver medal at an Olympic Games when she finished second in the 49kg category in Tokyo.
 
• Chanu won the gold medal in the 48kg division at the 2017 World Championships in Anaheim and followed up with Commonwealth Games gold in 2018.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Saina Nehwal is related to Badminton.

 
 
• Saina Nehwal is an Indian professional badminton player.
 
• She won the Bronze medal in Olympic Games in London in 2012.
 
• She became the first Indian to win two singles gold medals in Commonwealth Games (2010 and 2018).
 
• She is honoured with awards:
 
 
• Arjuna Award in 2009
 
• Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna in 2010
 
• Padma Shri in 2010
 
• Padma Bhushan in 2016

• PV Sindhu
 
 
• The full name of her is Pusarla Venkata Sindhu .She is a world-famous Indian female badminton player.
 
• PV Sindhu won two consecutive medals at the Olympics- silver in the 2016 Rio Games and bronze at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics.
 
• In the year 2021 she won a a silver at the Badminton World Federation (BWF).
 
• She was also the winner of the Syed Modi International Badminton title in January 2022.
 
• She became the first Indian to win a historic Gold at the Badminton World Championships in 2019.
 
• She also won the inaugural BBC Indian Sportswoman of the year award in 2019 following a public vote.
